consequence.statement: After upgrade existing services without a protocol are preserved as is to avoid disruption, and must be deleted and recreated for the agent to take their protocol into account; on downgrade, services with protocol set are deleted and recreated without it, causing connection disruptions.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.17 adds service protocol differentiation (enabled by default, controlled by --bpf-lb-proto-diff); existing services without a protocol are preserved and must be deleted and recreated for the protocol to be taken into account.
